newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: ATHLETICS-ETHIOPIA'S GEBRSELASSIE TO MISS ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-ETHIOPIA'S GEBRSELASSIE TO MISS ATHENS.

text.p: Ethiopia's Olympic 10,000 metres champion and world record holder Haile Gebrselassie said on Monday he would not participate in the world championships in Athens because the track was too hard.

"I competed the Atlanta Olympics 10,000 metres event suffering great injuries with blood flowing from my soles. It took me a long time to recover from that injury and I do not want to undergo similar sufferings," he told reporters.
Gebrselassie broke the 10,000 metres world record at the Bislett Games in Norway earlier this month.
Gebrselassie said he decided to pull out after hearing the Athens track was similar to the one used at the Atlanta Olympics, which he said favoured sprinters at the expense of distance runners.
An official of the Ethiopian Athletic Federation said he was unaware of Gebrselassie's decision.
"As far as we are concerned, Haile is among the 24 Ethiopian athletes selected for the Athens games and he is participating in training without fail," said the official who declined to be named.
